name: mystmd-lsp-vscode
description: Completion, warnings and navigation for MyST Markdown projects, from the mystmd-lsp language server

mystmdLsp.serverPath.description: Path to another build of the server, such as dist/server.cjs from a mystmd-lsp clone, instead of the bundled one. Reload the window after changing it.

mystmdLsp.execute.markdownDescription: Run code cells and inline `{eval}` expressions when mystmd builds, with `myst start --execute`. This runs the project's code, and needs Jupyter. Reload the window after changing it.

scripts.package: npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies -o mystmd-lsp.vsix
